description: Connect your Pocket Runway account to see what’s actually safe to spend until payday. Check your daily spending allowance, see upcoming obligations, understand how your current pay period is funded and allocated, and test how a hypothetical purchase would affect your runway. Pocket Runway uses your existing pay-period plan and financial data to provide deterministic safe-to-spend calculations. The ChatGPT integration is read-only and cannot modify your Pocket Runway account.

defaultPrompt: Is this bill already in my recurring plan?
What bills do I have coming up over the next 30 days?
Does this bill match what I already have planned?
